candidates.requirement: XInclude context processing must be reachable with the supported structured error handler and caller data configured, so its errors and delegated parser/XPath errors can reach that callback.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput creates an XInclude context, sets flags, processes the document, checks the last error, then frees the context. It never calls xmlXIncludeSetErrorHandler.
candidates.failure_condition: For every fuzz input, context creation clears errorHandler and errorCtxt; the target leaves them unchanged. A supported non-null handler state, and therefore callback delivery with caller data, cannot occur.
candidates.alternative_paths: Input bytes control options, entities, URL and XML, but are never passed as a handler or caller data. The target's global generic error callback does not configure the XInclude context's structured callback. No other setter call occurs in the complete entry.
